Meanwhile, Bobbi takes a dozen pregnancy tests and finally accepts that she’s pregnant. When the tests are discovered, she finds herself roped into Robert’s misguided hunt for twelve frightened pregnant young students.. Dwyer has a new lady in his life and seems happier than he’s been in a long time. Nisha couldn’t be more pleased for him, until she discovers that his new love interest bears a striking resemblance to the sketch composite of the suspect in his late wife’s murder case.

programme.title: Mr. D
programme.desc: It’s almost the end of the school year, and Gerry seems to be the only teacher at Xavier who hasn’t been offered a full-time contract for next fall. Even after Gerry plays the marriage card, it seems Lisa can’t guarantee him anything beyond fulltime substitute. Unwilling to accept this fate, Gerry gets an idea to start his own Charter school. Meanwhile, Robert and Bobbi interview applicants to fill Bobbi’s position while she’s away on maternity leave. Her initial concern about finding a qualified candidate is replaced with a deep insecurity that she won’t even be missed when the candidates prove quite overqualified. Lisa pulls out all the stops to throw an end-of-year faculty party. But when her efforts seem to go unappreciated, Lisa makes a bold move.

Meanwhile, Dwyer learns the ropes to his newly appointed position of Vice Principal; and Nisha, fresh off her camp counsellor summer job, struggles to reset boundaries with three seniors.

programme.title: Angie Gensler
programme.desc: News - Angie Gensler is a mother and personal trainer who was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis in 2004. In this episode, Mathew Embry speaks with Angie about her diagnosis and why she ultimately chose not to pursue drug treatments. Instead, she focused on lifestyle changes including diet, exercise, and daily discipline. Along the way she faced several major challenges including a serious car accident, a hysterectomy, and the effects of menopause, all while continuing to pursue optimal health and eventually stepping onto the competitive bodybuilding stage in her 50s. Her story is an inspiration to anyone navigating a difficult diagnosis.

programme.title: Angie Gensler
programme.desc: News - Angie Gensler is a mother and personal trainer who was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis in 2004. In this episode, Mathew Embry speaks with Angie about her diagnosis and why she ultimately chose not to pursue drug treatments. Instead, she focused on lifestyle changes including diet, exercise, and daily discipline. Along the way she faced several major challenges including a serious car accident, a hysterectomy, and the effects of menopause, all while continuing to pursue optimal health and eventually stepping onto the competitive bodybuilding stage in her 50s. Her story is an inspiration to anyone navigating a difficult diagnosis.
